Aisha Gomez: Dropping a new compact solution brief draft for enterprise buyers. Focus: Security, SLA tiers, and when to pick Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ent-brief-v2
Mason Reed: Nice. We need a short benchmark narrative box that sales can read aloud in 10s. Keep numbers conservative.
Celine Park: I'll write the 3-line bench: Hosted 480ms ($9/1k tokens); Dedicated 140ms ($4.5/1k); Private 170ms ($5.5/1k). Note: model & seq length matter.
Aisha Gomez: Love it. Put that under "What to expect" with a parenthetical "conservative p95 examples".
Noah Vega: Webinar plan: 18m demo, 12m SRE panel, 10m CISO Q&A. Field wants a live customer if possible.
Aisha Gomez: Draft CTA variations for A/B test:
A) "Secure inference, predictable SLAs"
B) "SLA playbook for regulated apps"
Which should go to paid social?
Mason Reed: Use A for social. Use B for targeted AE outreach. We'll measure MQL by 7 days.
Celine Park: Routing rules for intake (SFDC + webhook sample) so Field Ops can auto-queue leads. Drafted:
```
# Marketing form -> webhook -> populate SFDC
payload: {
  "vertical": "string",
  "annual_spend_est": "number",
  "compliance_level": "low|medium|high",
  "needs_private_deploy": "boolean"
}
# Routing logic (pseudo):
if payload.compliance_level == "high" or payload.vertical in ["healthcare","gov"]:
  assign -> enterprise_queue + tag:requires-compliance-review
elif payload.annual_spend_est >= 200000:
  assign -> dedicated_sales_queue
elif payload.needs_private_deploy == true:
  assign -> private-deploy-team
else:
  assign -> growth_selfserve
```
Noah Vega: Add note: when needs_private_deploy=true, AE must ask for infra contact and encryption key flow.
Aisha Gomez: Added. Also included 3 quick objection responses for AE copy: cost, control, fallback. Make them copy-pasteable.
Mason Reed: For messaging iteration: propose A/B test subject lines for the webinar email. Cohort split 50/50; measure CTR and event signups; follow up drip if not opened after 48h.
Celine Park: Landing page microcopy ready: headline, 3 bullets, CTA. Uploaded hero image request to Design: icons labeled "Hosted • Dedicated • Private" but using a horizontal lock-server-cloud motif.
Design: Got the brief. Will deliver hero + social cards in 36 hours.
Field Ops: Once design is in, we'll export 1-page PDF, 1-slide cheat, and a short 3-email nurture sequence. Add UTMs for tracking.
